_note: Delegation budget contract (delegation_budget_contract_v1): one file per delegated computation / verification workstream, written by the coordinator BEFORE dispatch, kept under team/delegations/. A delegated executor's default drift is to refine precision indefinitely and to expand scope; a delegation without explicit budgets is drift by construction. Validation is fail-closed (check_delegation_budget.py): a missing field, an unfilled <placeholder>, or an unknown contract_version does not pass.
workstream: <one line: what is delegated (the computation / verification task, its deliverable)>

tolerance_ceiling._note: Choose exactly one stopping form. NUMERIC (this shape, or omit mode): keep mode "numeric" and a finite positive value; reaching the ceiling means STOP, not 'keep improving'. EXACT_PREDICATE (for an exact-only task with no approximation tolerance): replace mode "numeric" and value with mode "exact_predicate" and predicate "<one line: exact boolean/equality condition that ends the task>". Never encode exactness as numeric zero. In both forms, anchor_note states which task requirement derives the stopping condition, never what the method can achieve.
tolerance_ceiling.anchor_note: <one line: which task requirement derives this stopping condition>

time_box._note: Hard wall-clock budget for the whole workstream. On expiry the executor wraps up from the atomic results already flushed to disk (see the research-harness long-running-jobs contract) — it never voids the batch.

max_attempts: <positive integer: cap on 'one last attempt' retries; exhausting it means wrap up, not retry>
scope_negative_list: <expansions the executor must NOT undertake on its own initiative, e.g.:>
<no building a full test suite beyond the delegated checks>
launches_full_scale_computation: <boolean: true when the workstream launches a full-scale computation (then the measured memory form is required); MANDATORY false for a declared_cap contract — absent fails closed there>

peak_memory_estimate._note: Two machine-checked forms. MEASURED (this shape — for workstreams launching a computation whose scale could threaten memory): dry_run_peak_rss_mb measured on a single-unit dry run BEFORE the full launch (estimating wall-clock alone is not a resource estimate), heap_limit_mb >= dry_run_peak_rss_mb. DECLARED_CAP (for short bounded workstreams launching no such computation, e.g. a quick verification pass or symbolic/review-only task): replace dry_run_peak_rss_mb with "mode": "declared_cap" and add "basis": one line stating why a dry-run measurement is not warranted. Do not measure an unrelated command's RSS just to fill the measured form.
peak_memory_estimate.dry_run_peak_rss_mb: <finite positive number: peak RSS of the single-unit dry run, in MB>
peak_memory_estimate.heap_limit_mb: <finite positive number: explicit heap cap for the full run, in MB>
peak_memory_estimate.dry_run_ref: <optional: pointer to the dry-run log / checkpoint that produced the measurement>

on_budget_exhausted: wrap up from flushed atomic results; record abandoned approaches in the failed-approaches ledger (failed_approaches_v1)
_independence_requirement_note: OPTIONAL BLOCK `independence_requirement` — MANDATORY whenever the acceptance criterion for the delegated work demands two or more independent routes/confirmations (blind re-derivations, independent recomputation). Shape: {"routes_required": positive int (routes acceptance needs), "routes_budgeted_here": positive int (routes THIS budget is sized for), "per_route_seconds_floor": positive int (declared minimum wall-clock seconds one route needs), "routes_execution": "sequential" (conservative default when absent) or "concurrent", "remaining_routes_source": one line naming where the routes beyond routes_budgeted_here come from — required exactly when routes_budgeted_here < routes_required, forbidden otherwise}. Machine-checked joint satisfiability (INDEPENDENCE_BUDGET_UNSATISFIABLE): sequential routes stack their floors (time_box.seconds must fit routes_budgeted_here * per_route_seconds_floor); concurrent routes share the wall clock (the box must fit one full floor). An explicit null block is rejected. Freezing an acceptance target of N independent routes over a budget that admits fewer is self-defeating by construction: the budget, not the science, dictates the 'not converged' verdict and the same work is re-dispatched to hit the same wall.
_retry_of_note: OPTIONAL BLOCK `retry_of` — MANDATORY on any contract/amendment that re-dispatches work whose previous contract ended by budget exhaustion. Shape: {"supersedes": one line naming the previous contract revision / delegation id, "exhausted_budget": one of time_box_seconds | max_attempts | heap_limit_mb | unit_ceiling | other, "measured_requirement": the MEASURED need in the exhausted dimension (finite positive number for time_box_seconds/heap_limit_mb in the same units; a number or one line otherwise — for max_attempts a one-line value states the approach change of a retry that keeps its cap), "adjustment_note": one line deriving THIS contract's budget from the measurement}. Machine-checked (RETRY_BUDGET_BELOW_MEASURED_NEED): the matching budget field (time_box.seconds, heap_limit_mb, max_attempts) must STRICTLY EXCEED a numeric measurement — a budget-boundary death measures a censored lower bound, so equality is the exhausted number with a stamp on it. An explicit null block is rejected. One measured re-budget decision — never a chain of identical exhaustions.
